questions.question: At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 162, against Heat on 2015/10/18.

questions.question: At which ground did Selaelo Mphahele record their career-best innings (26, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/06.

questions.question: Who has achieved the 50+ runs and 5+ wickets in a match double more times, Jessica Candler or Dané van Niekerk?
questions.explanation: Jessica Candler: 1 times. Dané van Niekerk: 2 times.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2016 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2016.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 5-Wicket Hauls' in the 12/13 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Kaylee Stadler holds it, with a total of 1, a joint record shared with Yumna Plowker.
